verdict.rationale: Lindy is an automation platform, so durable long-running workflows are a fair question. The evidence only shows routines that run on a schedule or trigger. That is recurring execution, not workflows that wait for days and keep their state through worker or platform restarts, and nothing documents durable waits, checkpointing or crash recovery.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run long-lived workflows that wait for days and survive worker or platform restarts without losing state
